why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 1 tests only that clamp is exported and returns x limited to lo..hi; every case, including the boundaries and lo===hi, follows from those words. Check 2 tests only that calls with lo>hi throw a RangeError. Check 3 requires an entry for each exported function that "names it and describes what it does", which is a fair reading of "documents". The note "(expect at least add, subtract, multiply, clamp)" is a hint about what the command will print, not an extra test. Check 4 is just "no failing tests". The stricter items are all under "Advisory": the grep screen, placement under "## API", mentioning RangeError in the README, exit status 0, added clamp tests and the error message wording. No PASS or FAIL condition goes beyond its expect line.
